assessments.importing_feature: Optional local text-embedding fallback for MCP tool search
assessments.mitigation: Hayba calls only the feature-extraction text pipeline with strings; it never supplies image/SVG input to Sharp. Ollama is attempted first and lexical search remains available when the optional backend fails.

assessments.importing_feature: Optional local text embeddings backed by ONNX Runtime
assessments.mitigation: The transitive AdmZip reference belongs to ONNX Runtime's package installation script, not Hayba's runtime embedding calls. Installs are lockfile-integrity-pinned; CI audit jobs use --ignore-scripts. Runtime archive extraction remains separately reachable and blocking under #377.

assessments.importing_feature: ONNX Runtime installation for the optional local text-embedding fallback
assessments.mitigation: #377 removed every Hayba runtime AdmZip import and replaced external archive handling with bounded streaming extraction. The sole remaining package is transitive to ONNX Runtime's postinstall binary installer; security workflows use --ignore-scripts and the lockfile pins integrity.

assessments.importing_feature: Native inference runtime for the optional local text-embedding fallback
assessments.mitigation: ONNX Runtime declares AdmZip for its postinstall binary installer; Hayba does not invoke that archive reader at runtime. Lockfile integrity pins the package and security workflows install with lifecycle scripts disabled.

assessments.importing_feature: Image-processing dependency shipped by the optional Transformers backend
assessments.mitigation: The Hayba backend accepts text strings only and selects a text feature-extraction model. It does not expose Transformers image processors or pass SVG/image bytes to Sharp.
